<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Restock" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restock">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restock" name="Inventory Restock Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Restock">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse Staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Monitor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ThresholdReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlertSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManualStockCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlertJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_StockReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectQuality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShelveStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Procurement" name="Procurement Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InventorySystem" name="Inventory System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventoryLevels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Restocked</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Monitor" name="Inventory monitoring begins"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached?"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlertSplit" name="Reorder signal type"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated reorder alert"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ManualStockCheck" name="Perform manual stock check"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlertJoin" name="Reorder need signaled"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier">
      <bpmn:documentation>Procurement team places the order considering cost, delivery time and supplier reliability.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StockReceived" name="Stock received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_StockReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record received stock in system"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ShelveStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Restocked" name="Restock complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMonitor" sourceRef="Start_Monitor" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThreshold" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevel > threshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Gateway_AlertSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevel <= threshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAutomatedAlert" name="Automated" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertSplit" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${alertMode == 'automated'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToManualCheck" name="Manual" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertSplit" targetRef="Task_ManualStockCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${alertMode == 'manual'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_AlertJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ManualStockCheck" targetRef="Gateway_AlertJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertJoin" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrderToUpdateDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDeliveryToReceive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Event_StockReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToInspect" sourceRef="Event_StockReceived" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToRecord" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToShelve" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_ShelveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShelveToUpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_ShelveStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevelsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="End_Restocked"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
